differences.what: A's top outer edge and corner are crisp, with a clean chamfer and a defined silhouette against the white; in B the right edge dissolves into a neon-green glow that bleeds into the background, so the product has no outline
B's top rim is a blurry, oversaturated green band with smeared internal shapes, not readable as a glass edge; A shows the top face as a legible bevelled slab with a believable falloff
A's slot shows interior depth with a lit lower lip and a visible back wall; B's slot is a flat near-black void (median luminance about 25 against 72 in A) that reads as a hole in the image
B's internal panels are a single flat dark olive with almost no tonal gradation and look muddy; A's panels have soft gradients and lighter values, so the material reads better
B shows a dowel or pin sticking out past the body on the right, which reads as a stray part floating in the glow; A keeps that hardware small and contained

A's top surface is washed out almost to white with a green cast in the upper left and a cut-off shape at the top-left corner, so the frame feels overexposed and unfinished there; B's framing is cleaner above the product
A shows small orange specks where the rods meet the surface, which read as artefacts
